review_method: Read the complete clarification; inspect exact productionAuthorization schema candidate/candidate_base required SHA40 fields, approved plan baseline and new prepare/publish/preflight contracts plus entire workflow-order section; inspect actual unchanged candidate source and nearby distinct task head/base call sites. Independently SHA256-bind all four artifacts/source. Existing independent unit-plan review reports approve_plan with no findings. This is a narrow factual term clarification, not a repeated full unit-plan/source review. No imports, tests, Git mutation, SSH or live action performed.

assessment.actual_parent_semantics: Actual controller.candidate applies the optional patch to the local index, writes its tree and invokes git commit-tree -S <tree> -p task[head] -m 'Temporary visual candidate'. Exactly one -p is passed; task[base] is not a parent argument. The function then pushes only agent-visual/<candidate> and dispatches that candidate. Consequently production.authorization.candidate_base correctly denotes the temporary signed candidate's sole parent, the feature/PR task head.
assessment.plan_compatibility: The approved additive prepare contract explicitly preserves existing patch/tree/parent/message semantics while retaining exact task/head/base bindings and separating all push/comment/dispatch effects. Interpreting candidate_base as reviewed dev base would contradict that unchanged sole-parent implementation whenever PR head differs from dev. The clarification resolves the existing term without adding/defaulting wire fields or changing the source identity contract.
assessment.dev_base_remains_distinct: Reviewed dev base task[base] remains in the complete task/plan/Gate proof and actual current caller admission. A sole-parent or current-PR-head check cannot establish private reviewed dev-base freshness, task alignment, current global/source controls or an actual Gate. The clarification explicitly retains those independent checks rather than replacing them with Git ancestry. This term is about temporary visual candidates; it does not redefine feature-publication commit parent handling.
assessment.remote_preexecution_checks: Before candidate checkout/execution, the fixed trusted preflight must authenticate the exact temporary ref/candidate, exactly one commit parent equal to candidate_base, actual current PR head equal to that same feature-head identity and dev target. All existing open/current PR, App/monitor/source/purpose/nonce/receipt/request/Gate/expiry/control checks remain conjunctive; no check is waived by this clarification. Wrong, absent or additional parent, moved PR head, wrong dev target or moved source rejects before candidate execution.
assessment.meaningful_regression_scope: A positive fixture with distinct feature head and reviewed dev base must establish the preserved parent semantics; separate negatives cover wrong/extra/no parent and current PR/dev/source movement. The local prepared/task and true Gate bindings must still retain the distinct dev base. Synthetic App fixtures must stay honestly synthetic and do not prove actual production readiness.
